description: Experimental Piko Tor based on Piko 3.10.0. Requires the separate Piko Tor 0.2.0 companion (version code 2+). Tor ON routes X through Tor while other apps keep their ordinary network; OFF restores direct X connectivity. Retained-TUN engine failure blocks affected X traffic, but unexpected tunnel loss without optional Android lockdown can allow direct connectivity. Lockdown can block other apps and change OFF behavior. See release notes for measured limits and old-companion signing migration. No exhaustive leak-prevention claim or detached bundle signature; SHA256SUMS records integrity only.
